description:
Speed up computer, clean your PC, and protect your private data. AI makes everything easier, and extraordinary.

IObit Advanced SystemCare is a comprehensive PC optimization tool designed to enhance performance and security. Using AI, this software cleans junk files, optimizes system settings, and speeds up your computer. Privacy protection is a priority, with features to clear traces and block suspicious processes. With Internet Booster and real-time tune-up, Advanced SystemCare ensures your PC runs smoothly and efficiently.
v20.0 (2026-10-15)
- Brand-New Custom Clean: Quickly identifies duplicate and large files to reclaim valuable disk space effortlessly
- Next-Gen Scan Engine: Supports multi-module sync scanning, significantly reducing overall scan time
- New Network Speed Monitoring: Tracks real-time upload/download speeds to instantly pinpoint bandwidth-heavy background tasks
- New Disk Temperature Monitoring: Displays live temperature insights to prevent overheating, protecting your disk health
- Enhanced Junk File Clean: Removes residual files from more applications, including Microsoft Store apps, to maximize free space
- Expanded Anti-Spyware Database: Removes more spyware threats for a rock-solid, secure system
- Enhanced Startup Optimization: Manages a wider range of startup items to accelerate PC boot‑up and overall runtime speed
- Upgraded Software Updater: Supports updating more popular third-party software and Microsoft Store apps
- Improved Surfing Protection: Blocks more annoying ads and malicious sites for safer, clutter‑free web browsing
- Strengthened Privacy Sweep: Removes more privacy traces to protect your privacy better
- Improved Safe Folder: Effortlessly locks down your sensitive or private files against unauthorized access
- Redesigned UI: Delivers intuitive interactions and modern aesthetics for a seamless experience
- Localization: Supports 37 localized languages worldwide
- Dozens of general performance optimizations, stability improvements, and bug fixes
